title: 第一卷 第9章 丹房第一卷 第10章 图个轻松自在
content_zh:
丹房负责人是个十七八的青年，穿着宽松的灰色道袍，是飞仙门的外门弟子。
他搜身时极为严苛，让陈玄脱了衣服，将衣服里里外外都翻了个遍，确认无误后丢给他。
青年又将行囊翻了个遍，只找出几件破衣服、一个白玉瓶，以及一个黑黢黢的陶罐子。
他先打开塞子看了眼玉瓶里面，放在手上倒了倒，见没有任何东西，又凑在鼻子上闻了闻，才放到一边，随即蹲下身端起陶罐仔细翻看。
陈玄看着青年的动作，吞了口唾沫，心提到嗓子眼。
青年放下陶罐子，抓起玉瓶问陈玄道，“这瓶子以前装过仙丹，而且品质不低，说说吧，哪儿来的。”
陈玄松了口气，穿好衣服，说道，“是一位上仙给的，此事张头儿知晓。”
他没有过多解释，说得多了反而容易出纰漏。
青年看向候在一旁的张头儿，投去询问的眼神。
“确实是栾仙子给的，昨日因药田之事，苏仙子错怪了陈玄，这瓶仙丹是栾仙子补偿给他的。”张头儿肯定了陈玄的说法。
陈玄心中给张头儿比了个大拇指，连缘由都帮他想好了，真是个好人呐……
看到瓶子已经空了，张头儿有些狐疑，看向陈玄道，“瓶子里不是还有三颗仙丹吗？你不会全吃了吧！”
陈玄点头，装作无奈道，“昨晚回去就全吃了，不仅没能治愈身上的伤，还差点把我疼死，这要不是栾仙子给的，我都怀疑是不是假的！”
张头儿瞪大眼睛，“你敢一次吃三颗金骨丹？没疼死你都算你命大！不是我说你，咱们资质也就这样了，以后千万别为了修行做傻事！”
陈玄闻言一阵后怕，竟然这么严重，怪不得早上那会疼得死去活来，看来他能挺过来，极有可能是陶罐提升了丹药品质。
青年听着两人对话，心中有些诧异，因一个误会竟补偿了一瓶金骨丹，栾仙子出手真是阔绰，但是一想到她圣女的身份，也就不足为奇了。
将玉瓶塞回行囊中，看着陈玄直摇头，啧啧道，“也就这个瓶子值点钱，你可真够穷的。”
陈玄也挤出一抹笑，“我就是个杂役，又没有月俸，买不起什么东西。”
青年嗯了一声，看向张头儿，“没什么问题，你可以回去了，他以后就留在这边，没什么重要的事不要来打扰。”
“是……师兄！”张头儿满脸笑意，客客气气地打了个稽首，转身朝山下走去。

仙门就是这样，身份高一等压死人，张头儿在杂役院耀武扬威，但是碰上个外门弟子，也得恭恭敬敬喊一声“师兄”。
青年将行囊丢给陈玄，指了指丹房旁边的小房间，说道，“平时咱就住那边的房子，你去里面那一间，把东西放好出来找我，给你安排今后要做的事。”
“好嘞！”
陈玄咧嘴一笑，提起陶罐、抱着行囊快步走到房门口，开门钻了进去。
关上房门，倚在门后大口喘气，后背已经被冷汗浸透。
幸亏那陶罐不起眼，不然今天就完了！
那是他唯一翻身的资本，无论如何都要带在身边。
稍微缓了口气，环顾房间四周。
整体跟杂役院的房子差不多，只是要大出不少，床上还有床被褥，应该是上一个住客留下的，陈玄不打算丢，这样以后就可以不用睡干床板了。
content_en:
The person in charge of the alchemy room is a young man in his late teens, wearing a loose gray robe, and is an outer disciple of the Feixian Sect.
He was very strict when searching him. He asked Chen Xuan to take off his clothes, turned the clothes inside and out, and threw them to him after confirming that they were correct.
The young man rummaged through his luggage again and found only a few tattered clothes, a white jade bottle, and a black clay pot.
He first opened the stopper and looked inside the jade bottle, put it in his hand and poured it out. When he saw that there was nothing there, he put it to his nose and smelled it, then put it aside. Then he squatted down and picked up the clay pot and looked through it carefully.
Chen Xuan looked at the young man's movements and swallowed, his heart in his throat.
The young man put down the pottery jar, grabbed the jade bottle and asked Chen Xuandao, "This bottle has been used to contain elixirs, and the quality is not low. Tell me where it came from."
Chen Xuan breathed a sigh of relief, put on his clothes, and said, "It was given by an immortal, and Mr. Zhang knows about it."
He didn't explain too much. If he said too much, he would easily make mistakes.
The young man looked at Zhang Tou'er who was waiting aside and cast a questioning look.
"It was indeed given by Fairy Luan. Yesterday, Fairy Su wrongly blamed Chen Xuan for the incident in the medicine field. This bottle of elixir was given to him by Fairy Luan as compensation." Head Zhang confirmed Chen Xuan's statement.
Chen Xuan gave Zhang a thumbs up in his heart and even thought of the reasons for him. He is such a good person...
Seeing that the bottle was empty, Zhang Tou'er was a little suspicious and looked at Chen Xuandao, "Aren't there still three elixirs in the bottle? You won't eat them all!"
Chen Xuan nodded and pretended to be helpless and said, "I ate it all when I went back last night. Not only did it fail to heal the wounds on my body, but it almost hurt me to death. If Fairy Luan hadn't given this to me, I would have doubted it was a fake!"
Zhang Tou'er's eyes widened, "How dare you take three Golden Bone Pills at one time? Even if it doesn't hurt you to death, you're lucky! I'm not telling you, our qualifications are just like this. Don't do stupid things for the sake of cultivation in the future!"
Chen Xuan was frightened for a while after hearing this. It was so serious. No wonder he was in so much pain in the morning. It seemed that he could survive it. It was most likely that the clay pot improved the quality of the elixir.
The young man listened to the conversation between the two and was a little surprised. Because of a misunderstanding, he actually compensated for a bottle of Golden Bone Pill. Fairy Luan was really generous, but when she thought about her status as a saint, it was not surprising.
Stuffing the jade bottle back into his luggage, he looked at Chen Xuan and shook his head, tut-tutting, "This bottle is only worth a little money, you are really poor."
Chen Xuan also forced a smile, "I'm just a handyman, and I don't have a monthly salary, so I can't afford anything."
The young man hummed and looked at Mr. Zhang, "It's no problem. You can go back. He will stay here from now on. If there is nothing important, don't disturb him."
"It's...senior brother!" Zhang Tou'er smiled politely, nodded politely, turned around and walked down the mountain.
That's how it is in the Immortal Sect. Having a higher status puts people to death. Zhang Tou'er shows off his power in the courtyard, but when he meets an outside disciple, he has to respectfully call him "Senior Brother".
The young man threw his luggage to Chen Xuan, pointed to the small room next to the alchemy room, and said, "We usually live in the house over there. You go to the room inside, put your things away, and come out to me to arrange what you need to do in the future."
"Okay!"
Chen Xuan grinned, picked up the pottery pot, carried his luggage and walked quickly to the door of the room, opened the door and got in.
He closed the door and leaned against the door, gasping for air. His back was soaked with cold sweat.
Fortunately, the clay pot is inconspicuous, otherwise today would be over!
That was the only capital he had to survive, and he had to keep it with him no matter what.
He took a breath and looked around the room.
The overall house is similar to the house in the courtyard, except that it is much larger. There is also a quilt on the bed, which should have been left by the previous resident. Chen Xuan does not intend to throw it away, so that he will not have to sleep on a dry bed in the future.
